'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Announces Additional Cast
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki's Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? 'Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Song, Main Trailer
The official website of the Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e (To You in the Beyond) movie unveiled additional cast, the main visual (pictured right), and trailer on Wednesday. The anime movie adapting Akiko Abe's mystery romance novel was previewed at Anime Expo on July 4 and will open in Japanese theaters on October 9. Manga 'Studio Cabana' Gets TV Anime in 2027
Production company Kadokawa opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Aguri Uma's Studio Cabana on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will air in 2027. Voice actress Sayumi Suzushiro (Bocchi the Rock!) is starring as the lead female character Yukari Maki.
